purpose: Canonical real-company identity registry for Sprint consumer ordering UI.
hard_rule: No real company logo may be generated, approximated, semantically guessed, or sourced independently by a UI component.

merchants.name: Sprint Couriers
merchants.production_rule: Use only Sprint's approved internal corporate logo asset. Never redraw or AI-generate it.
wrong_asset_warnings: Do not use the prototype's yellow spotted 'Sprint Me' cheetah mark as the corporate logo.
Do not use Behance/Dribbble speculative redesigns.

merchants.name: Choppies
merchants.production_rule: Use approved Choppies red/green corporate identity. Merchant card must read as supermarket/groceries, not a random steak image.

merchants.name: Pick n Pay Botswana
merchants.production_rule: Use Botswana/Southern African Pick n Pay identity from official merchant assets.

merchants.name: SPAR Botswana
merchants.production_rule: Use official SPAR Botswana identity; do not infer a store variant without merchant/store metadata.

merchants.name: Sefalana
merchants.production_rule: Use official Sefalana/Shopper/Hyper/Quick banner identity that matches the specific store.

merchants.name: Checkers
merchants.production_rule: Use official South African Checkers retail identity only.
wrong_asset_warnings: Do not use checkers.co.zw / Checkers Office & Home branding.

merchants.name: Woolworths South Africa
merchants.production_rule: Use Woolworths South Africa black-square/white-W or approved wordmark.
wrong_asset_warnings: Never use the Australian Woolworths green apple/swirl identity.

merchants.name: KFC Botswana
merchants.production_rule: Use merchant-authorized KFC Botswana asset/CDN export; do not redraw Colonel mark.

merchants.name: Nando's Botswana
merchants.production_rule: Use official Nando's Botswana/Southern Africa identity. Full menu is store/location dependent; do not substitute another country's catalog.

merchants.name: RocoMamas Botswana
merchants.production_rule: Use only merchant-approved logo/graphics. Website terms restrict copying/distribution of graphics.

merchants.name: Clicks
merchants.production_rule: Use official Clicks corporate identity from merchant-approved assets. Botswana stock/pricing must be store-specific; do not import South African prices as Botswana prices.

merchants.name: Dis-Chem
merchants.production_rule: Use official Dis-Chem retail identity. Botswana inventory/pricing requires store-specific source; do not assume SA online inventory is available locally.

merchants.name: Chidzanani Pharmacy
merchants.production_rule: Use official Chidzanani Pharmacy asset after partner/rights approval.

merchants.name: Notwane Pharmacy
merchants.production_rule: Official site verifies merchant; request clean approved logo from merchant before production.

merchants.name: Medicine HQ / Pharma Group Botswana
merchants.production_rule: Use merchant-provided approved identity before production.
